models_evaluated: five commercially available TB predictive AI systems

links.outcome: False positives, false negatives and clinician workload when AI defers uncertain cases to clinical workflow
links.effect: Breast screening: 25% fewer false positives at same false-negative rate versus UK double reading with arbitration, with 66% less clinician workload. TB triage: 5-15% fewer false positives for three of five AI systems.
links.quote: For breast cancer screening, compared to double reading with arbitration in a screening program in the UK, CoDoC reduced false positives by 25% at the same false-negative rate, while achieving a 66% reduction in clinician workload.

unlisted_practices: Learned complementarity-driven deferral between predictive AI and clinical workflow

screen.reason: Evaluates a deferral framework (CoDoC) that selectively decides between AI predictions and clinical workflows to optimize safety, accuracy, and clinician workload in screening programs.
